name: DK Fast Expand
replayNeeds: UD DK opener with early expansion (~6:00 timing) — any pro game showing clear expo decision. Happy, 120, or Labyrinth preferred.

name: DK Ghoul Rush
replayNeeds: UD DK with mass Ghouls vs Night Elf — aggressive early game. Sometimes called 'ghoul pull' build. Any UDvNE game where ghouls are the primary army.

name: FS Fast Tech
replayNeeds: Orc Far Seer skipping Barracks, rushing Stronghold — fast tech build. FoCuS is known for this style. Any OvH game with no T1 combat units.

name: DH Mass Huntress
replayNeeds: NE Demon Hunter opener with fast Huntress production and map control. Any pro NE game with DH + Huntress focus.
